items.title: The Efficiency of Spare Capacity
items.topic: why systems may need apparently unused capacity in order to remain reliable during unexpected demand
items.benefit: high utilization can reduce visible waste and make expensive facilities appear more productive
items.challenge: a system operating near its maximum may have little ability to absorb emergencies, delays, equipment failure, or sudden increases in demand
items.lesson: efficiency should include the value of resilience rather than treating every unused resource as waste
items.topicJa: 予想外の需要に備える余力が一見無駄に見える問題
items.benefitJa: 高い稼働率は目に見える無駄を減らし高価な設備を効率的に使えること
items.challengeJa: 限界近くで動く仕組みは緊急事態や故障や需要急増を吸収する余力が小さいこと
items.lessonJa: 効率を考える際は未使用資源をすべて無駄とせず回復力の価値も含める必要がある

items.title: Who Benefits From Faster Decisions
items.topic: the tradeoff between speeding up administrative decisions and preserving opportunities for careful review
items.benefit: faster procedures can reduce waiting costs and allow people to receive services or decisions sooner
items.challenge: strict time limits may disadvantage complex cases that require translation, additional evidence, or consultation
items.lesson: process reforms should measure both speed and the quality and fairness of decisions across different kinds of cases
items.topicJa: 行政判断を速めることと慎重な審査機会を守ることの両立
items.benefitJa: 手続きの迅速化で待機負担を減らしサービスや判断を早く受けられること
items.challengeJa: 厳しい期限は翻訳や追加証拠や相談が必要な複雑な事例を不利にする可能性があること
items.lessonJa: 改革では速度だけでなく事例ごとの判断の質と公平性も測る必要がある

items.title: A Rule That Changes Behavior
items.topic: why measuring the effect of a new rule is difficult when people alter their behavior in anticipation of the rule
items.benefit: clear rules can encourage safer or more responsible behavior before penalties ever need to be imposed
items.challenge: if behavior changes before measurement begins, simple before-and-after comparisons may misidentify when and why the improvement occurred
items.lesson: evaluation should consider anticipation effects and seek comparison evidence that separates the rule from other changes
items.topicJa: 新しい規則を予想して人々が先に行動を変えると効果測定が難しくなる問題
items.benefitJa: 明確な規則は罰則を使う前から安全で責任ある行動を促せること
items.challengeJa: 測定開始前に行動が変わると単純な前後比較では改善の時期や原因を誤る可能性があること
items.lessonJa: 評価では予期効果を考え規則以外の変化と区別できる比較証拠を探す必要がある

items.title: The Problem With a Single Target
items.topic: how a useful performance target can distort behavior when institutions focus on the measured number rather than the underlying goal
items.benefit: a clear target can coordinate effort, make expectations visible, and reveal whether progress is occurring
items.challenge: workers may improve the reported metric through shortcuts, case selection, or neglect of important outcomes that are not measured
items.lesson: performance systems need multiple indicators, qualitative checks, and periodic review of whether the metric still represents the real objective
items.topicJa: 一つの成果指標への集中が本来の目的から行動をずらす問題
items.benefitJa: 明確な目標は努力をそろえ期待を見える化し進捗を確認しやすくすること
items.challengeJa: 測定値を上げるため近道や対象選別が起き測られない重要な成果が軽視される可能性があること
items.lessonJa: 複数指標と質的確認を組み合わせ指標が本来の目的を表しているか定期的に見直す必要がある
